90% of Landing Pages Make This Mistake

Swipe to find out →

" 65: }' 66: ``` 67: 68: ### Slides 2-6: Content Slides 69: 70: One point per slide. Never cram multiple ideas. 71: 72: ```bash 73: # Content slide template 74: belt app run infsh/html-to-image --input '{ 75: "html": "

01

Your headline is too vague

\"Welcome to our platform\" tells the visitor nothing. Lead with the outcome: \"Ship docs in minutes, not days.\"

" 76: }' 77: ``` 78: 79: ### Slide 7: CTA Slide 80: 81: ```bash 82: # CTA slide 83: belt app run infsh/html-to-image --input '{ 84: "html": "

Found this useful?

Save this post for later 🔖
Follow for more tips

@yourusername

" 85: }' 86: ``` 87: 88: ## Design Rules 89: 90: ### Text Hierarchy 91: 92: | Element | Size (at 1080px) | Weight | 93: |---------|-----------------|--------| 94: | Slide number | 96-120px | Black (900) | 95: | Heading | 48-64px | Bold (700-800) | 96: | Body text | 24-28px | Regular (400) | 97: | Caption/tag | 18-22px | Medium (500) | 98: 99: ### Readability 100: 101: | Rule | Value | 102: |------|-------| 103: | Max words per slide | 30-40 | 104: | Max lines of body text | 4-5 | 105: | Line height | 1.5-1.6 | 106: | Font | Sans-serif (Inter, Montserrat, Poppins) | 107: | Text contrast | 4.5:1 minimum (WCAG AA) | 108: 109: ### Visual Consistency 110: 111: | Element | Keep Consistent Across All Slides | 112: |---------|----------------------------------| 113: | Background color/gradient | Same palette, slight variations OK | 114: | Font family | Same font throughout | 115: | Text alignment | Same position (left or center) | 116: | Margins/padding | Same spacing | 117: | Accent color | Same highlight color | 118: | Numbering style | Same format (01, 02 or 1., 2.) | 119: 120: ## Carousel Types 121: 122: ### Educational / Tips 123: 124: ``` 125: Slide 1: "5 CSS tricks you need to know" 126: Slide 2: Trick 1 with code example 127: Slide 3: Trick 2 with code example 128: ... 129: Slide 6: Trick 5 with code example 130: Slide 7: "Follow for more dev tips" 131: ``` 132: 133: ### Storytelling / Case Study 134: 135: ``` 136: Slide 1: "How we grew from 0 to $1M ARR" 137: Slide 2: The beginning (context) 138: Slide 3: The challenge 139: Slide 4: What we tried (failed) 140: Slide 5: What worked 141: Slide 6: The result (numbers) 142: Slide 7: Key takeaway + CTA 143: ``` 144: 145: ### Before / After 146: 147: ``` 148: Slide 1: "I redesigned this landing page" 149: Slide 2: Before screenshot 150: Slide 3: Problem 1 annotated 151: Slide 4: After screenshot 152: Slide 5: Improvement 1 explained 153: Slide 6: Results (conversion lift) 154: Slide 7: "Want a review? DM me" 155: ``` 156: 157: ### Listicle / Tools 158: 159: ``` 160: Slide 1: "10 tools every designer needs in 2025" 161: Slides 2-6: 2 tools per slide with logo + one-liner 162: Slide 7: "Save this for later 🔖" 163: ``` 164: 165: ## Swipe Psychology 166: 167: | Principle | Application | 168: |-----------|------------| 169: | **Curiosity gap** | Hook promises value that requires swiping | 170: | **Numbered progress** | "3/7" creates completion drive | 171: | **Visual continuity** | Consistent design signals "there's more" | 172: | **Increasing value** | Best tip last — rewards completing | 173: | **Swipe cue** | Arrow or "Swipe →" on slide 1 | 174: 175: ## Batch Generation 176: 177: ```bash 178: # Generate all slides for a carousel 179: for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do 180: belt app run infsh/html-to-image --input "{ 181: \"html\": \"

Slide $i of 7

\" 182: }" --no-wait 183: done 184: ``` 185: 186: ## AI-Generated Carousel Visuals 187: 188: ```bash 189: # Generate illustrations for each slide 190: belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora --input '{ 191: "prompt": "minimal flat illustration, person at desk with laptop, clean modern style, simple shapes, limited color palette purple and blue tones, white background, icon style", 192: "width": 1080, 193: "height": 1080 194: }' 195: ``` 196: 197: ## Common Mistakes 198: 199: | Mistake | Problem | Fix | 200: |---------|---------|-----| 201: | Weak hook (slide 1) | Nobody swipes | Bold claim, question, or number + promise | 202: | Too much text per slide | Overwhelming, stops reading | Max 30-40 words per slide | 203: | No visual consistency | Looks like different posts | Same colors, fonts, margins throughout | 204: | No swipe indicator | People don't realize there's more | Add "Swipe →" or arrow on slide 1 | 205: | No CTA on last slide | Missed engagement opportunity | Ask to save, follow, share, or comment | 206: | Inconsistent numbering | Feels disorganized | Same number format on every content slide | 207: | Cramming 2+ ideas per slide | Hard to digest | One point per slide, always | 208: | Square format on Instagram | Wastes feed real estate | Use 1080x1350 (4:5) for more visibility | 209: 210: ## Related Skills 211: 212: ```bash 213: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@ai-image-generation 214: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@content-repurposing 215: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@linkedin-content 216: ``` 217: 218: Browse all apps: `belt app list` 219: "}}
